name: kantzen-ui
description: Reusable React interface system for Kantzen workspace applications and websites.

scripts.build:packages: npm run clean:packages && npm run build --workspace @patkepa/kantzen-ui && npm run build --workspace @patkepa/kantzen-starlight
scripts.format: prettier --write packages examples scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.package.json eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages examples scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.package.json eslint.config.js
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build:packages && npm publish --access public --workspace @patkepa/kantzen-ui && npm publish --access public --workspace @patkepa/kantzen-starlight
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:packages && npm run build:starlight
scripts.test:packages: node scripts/smoke-packages.mjs && npm run test --workspace @patkepa/kantzen-ui && npm run test --workspace @patkepa/kantzen-starlight
